title: TAT-3833 negative control: abandon_order assertion detects an uncommitted exit
description: Lands on the lower-cased ETH modify form, then leaves it without submitting. That is a real abandonment, so the zero-abandon_order assertion must FAIL. Proves the assertion used by recipe.json is not vacuous. Precondition: MetaMetrics opted in on the slot profile (the harness set_consent action currently fails its read-back against main's AnalyticsController state); the one-trading-screen-view expectation fails loudly if events are not captured.

setup-analytics-capture.intent: Start the local Segment collector the build's SEGMENT_HOST points at

reset.intent: Let queued events flush (5s Segment interval), then clear captured events so the modify assertion only sees the redirect landing

land-lowercase.intent: Land on the modify form through a lower-cased symbol in a fresh page load

wait-form.intent: Modify form shows the open ETH position reached through the lower-cased route

leave-uncommitted.intent: Leave the modify form without submitting: a genuine abandonment

assert-no-abandon.intent: Must FAIL: the uncommitted exit emits abandon_order
